title: FIR Intel extraction payload
description: Schema for a structured extraction from one FIR narrative. All slots and people must carry a verbatim quote from the narrative (Rule 4). Phones must be 10-digit Indian mobiles not in the stoplist. Rule 2: no person may have a name matching the unknown-accused list.

crime_type_conf.description: Confidence score for the crime_type classification (0–1).

mo_slots.description: Slot_name → {value, quote} pairs. Slot names must be allowed for this crime_type in data/mo_schema.json.

value.description: Extracted slot value (string, integer or boolean).

quote.description: Verbatim substring from the FIR narrative that supports this value (Rule 4).

phones.description: 10-digit Indian mobile numbers. Must not include stoplist numbers.

vehicle_regs.description: Full vehicle registration plates in uppercase with no spaces.

vehicle_last4.description: Last 4 digits of a partial registration plate.

vehicle_desc.description: Colour + make description, e.g. 'white swift dzire', or null.

people.description: Named persons extracted from the narrative (accused, victim mentions, witnesses).

name.description: Full name. Must not be an unknown-person placeholder (Rule 2).

role.description: Role of this person in the FIR.

quote.description: Verbatim substring from the FIR narrative that names or describes this person (Rule 4).
